entity.description: One data-defined read: a protocol and a definition document. The protocol says how core talks to the endpoint; everything system-specific is in definitionJson.

field.name: protocol
field.description: GRAPHQL or REST_JSON: the wire protocol, never a system.

field.name: definitionVersion
field.description: Raised on every change, so a run can say which version read its records.

field.name: statusId
field.description: DRAFT (validated, not used by any connector), ACTIVE, or RETIRED (kept for history).

field.name: definitionJson
field.description: {connection, limits, steps, record, counts}. Shape and rules: DataSourceDefinitionSupport and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-data-defined-order-items-read-design.md.
